title: Roster Candidates Response
description: PROV-06 typed payload for GET /recognition/clusters/{cluster_id}/roster-candidates. Candidates are labelled clusters; PHP maps cluster_id to roster_entry_id and collapses to one row per person. quality_flag is probe-level. Frontend must not show Strong when quality_flag is not ok. Unknown quality_flag values must be treated as low_quality. occluded is reserved (never fabricated).

model_id.description: Embedding-space identifier that produced the ranking scores.

embedding_model.description: Same space as model_id; repeated so consumers can bind FIR23-01 without guessing.

computed_at.description: When this ranking was computed. Similarity is not a stable person attribute.

probe_face_count.description: Number of dim-compatible probe representatives (or member-fallback faces) used in ranking. Three empties: no usable probe → probe_face_count 0, reference_face_count 0, quality_flag low_quality; empty labelled roster → probe_face_count > 0, reference_face_count 0, quality_flag ok, candidates []; low-quality probe → bands capped at possible.

reference_face_count.description: Number of same-space labelled reference vectors actually compared.

quality_flag.description: Probe-level quality gate. occluded is reserved. Unknown values → treat as low_quality. When not ok, band is capped at possible (FE must not show Strong).

data_source.description: Optional WordPress proxy provenance. Absent on the python 200 wire. Degraded proxy paths use HTTP 502/503 error envelopes instead of fabricating this 200 schema.

candidates.description: Server-ranked labelled clusters. Python top_k is cluster-grain. PHP fetches the Python max window (50), collapses to one row per roster_entry_id (max similarity wins, keep that row's band + name), re-sorts similarity DESC then cluster_id ASC, then slices people-grain top_k so a person split across N clusters cannot starve later people. roster_entry_id null rows are uncommittable and kept flagged.

name.description: Python: cluster label. PHP: acx_persons.name when mapped, else the cluster label.

similarity.description: Ranking cosine only; not a calibrated probability. May be negative (band none).

roster_entry_id.description: Local acx_persons.id filled by the WordPress passthrough; absent on the python wire. Null means unmapped / uncommittable.
